platforms.name: Apple Wallet
platforms.tagline: Add your digital ID or passport to iPhone
platforms.description: Apple Wallet supports state digital IDs, driver licenses, and US passports on iPhone and Apple Watch. The feature requires iOS 15.4 or later, and is accepted at select TSA checkpoints and participating businesses.
requirements: Apple Watch (optional — some states support it)
A participating state (see state list below)
A REAL ID-compliant driver license or state ID card
general_steps: Open the Wallet app on your iPhone.
Tap the + button in the top right corner.
Select 'Driver's License or State ID' (or 'US Passport' if applicable).
Choose your state from the list.
Follow the prompts to scan your physical ID and complete identity verification.
Wait for your state DMV to approve the request — this usually takes a few minutes.

step_groups.title: Adding a state driver's license or ID
steps: Open the Wallet app on your iPhone (iOS 15.4 or later required).
Tap the + button in the top right corner.
Select 'Driver's License or State ID'.
Choose your state from the list.
Scan the front and back of your physical driver's license or ID.
Complete the face and motion scan to verify your identity.
Your state DMV processes the request — approval typically takes a few minutes.

step_groups.title: Adding a US passport
steps: Open the Wallet app on your iPhone (iOS 16 or later required).
Tap the + button in the top right corner.
Select 'Passport'.
Scan the photo page of your US passport using your iPhone's camera.
Complete the face scan to verify your identity.
Apple processes your passport — it will appear in your wallet once verified.

platforms.accepted_where: TSA airport security checkpoints (select airports), and merchants and venues that accept Apple Wallet IDs.

platforms.name: Google Wallet
platforms.tagline: Add your digital ID or passport to Android
platforms.description: Google Wallet supports state digital IDs, driver licenses, and US passports on Android phones. Your credentials are stored securely on-device and can be presented at TSA checkpoints and participating locations.
requirements: Android phone running Android 9 or later
A participating state (see state list below)
A REAL ID-compliant driver license or state ID card
general_steps: Tap the + button to add a new card.
Tap 'ID documents', then 'Driver's license or state ID'.
Scan the front and back of your physical driver license or ID.
Your state DMV processes the request — approval typically takes a few minutes.

step_groups.title: Adding a state driver's license or ID
steps: Open the Google Wallet app.
Tap the + button to add a new card.
Tap 'ID documents', then 'Driver's license or state ID'.
Select your state from the list.
Scan the front and back of your physical driver's license or ID.
Complete the selfie and liveness verification.
Your state DMV processes the request — approval typically takes a few minutes.

step_groups.title: Adding a US passport
steps: Open the Google Wallet app.
Tap the + button to add a new card.
Tap 'ID documents', then 'Passport'.
Scan the photo page of your US passport using your phone's camera.
Complete the identity verification step.
Google processes your passport — it will appear in your wallet once verified.

platforms.accepted_where: TSA airport security checkpoints (select airports), and merchants and venues that accept Google Wallet IDs.

platforms.name: Samsung Wallet
platforms.tagline: Add your digital ID or passport to Samsung devices
platforms.description: Samsung Wallet supports state digital IDs on Samsung Galaxy phones in select states, and US passports through Samsung ID with CLEAR — a free digital ID backed by your US passport and verified by CLEAR. It's separate from a paid CLEAR+ airport membership and works for any US passport holder. It uses the same underlying ISO 18013-5 mDL standard as Apple and Google Wallet, and is accepted at more than 250 TSA checkpoints. (Reminder: TSA still recommends carrying a REAL ID-compliant document when you fly.)
supported_documents: US passport (via Samsung ID with CLEAR)
requirements: Samsung Galaxy phone with Samsung Wallet app
A valid US passport (for Samsung ID with CLEAR), or a participating state (for state IDs)
general_steps: Open the Samsung Wallet app on your Galaxy phone.
Tap + to add a new item.
Choose either Samsung ID with CLEAR (for US passport) or your state's ID.
Follow the prompts to verify your identity.
Wait for approval — typically just a few minutes.

step_groups.title: Adding a US passport (Samsung ID with CLEAR)
steps: Make sure you have a valid US passport handy.
Open the 'Quick Access' tab in Samsung Wallet.
Tap the + button.
Select 'Digital IDs'.
Select 'Samsung ID with CLEAR'.
Tap 'Get Card' and follow the prompts to scan your passport and verify your identity with CLEAR.
Once verified, your Samsung ID with CLEAR is ready to use at participating TSA checkpoints with a tap or QR scan.

step_groups.title: Adding a state driver's license or ID
steps: Open the Samsung Wallet app on your Galaxy phone.
Tap + to add a new item.
Select 'Digital IDs', then choose your state.
Scan the front and back of your physical driver's license or ID.
Complete the selfie and liveness verification.
Your state DMV processes the request — approval typically takes a few minutes.

platforms.accepted_where: More than 250 TSA airport security checkpoints (with Samsung ID with CLEAR), select sporting venues including BMO Stadium in Los Angeles, and locations that accept ISO 18013-5 mDLs. State ID acceptance varies by state.
